items.caption: Modern redraw of 兒 in oracle-bone script style, showing a person-like lower part beneath a distinct upper feature.
items.alt: Black oracle-script-style drawing of 兒, with a person-like lower shape beneath an open, forked upper shape.
items.selection_reason: Provides an early-script comparison for the child graph; its upper feature does not by itself establish what was depicted.

items.caption: Modern redraw of the 兒 form represented in the Shuowen seal-script tradition, with a rounded upper section above a person-like lower part.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style drawing of 兒, with a rounded upper section containing paired horizontal strokes above a person-like lower part.
items.selection_reason: Shows the received seal-script form relevant to the historical explanation and complements the oracle-style example; it is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: The upper feature in 兒 remains disputed: historical explanations identify it as an unclosed fontanel, while another interpretation sees paired hair buns. The drawings do not resolve that question.
